plan_text:
# Implementation Plan: one view of the sheet for the program example's captions (340)

**Spec**: `spec.md` (FAITHFUL, round 2) | **Measurements**: `harness.py` (`make spec-harness SPEC=specs/340-program-example-captions-hand-sheet-placer OUT=<json>`)

## Summary

Three steps, as the spec orders them: the composed draft declares its captions the hand sheets' way (additive - no seat
moves); a harness measures, on that one declared draft, every caption the composer and the hand-sheet placer seat
differently, attributing each to the entry's three sources and reporting what each of the entry's two fixes removes; then the
seating switches to the fix the measurement supports, per source, keeping feature 287's strict rule. D3 is decided by the
measurement and the plan is amended and re-reviewed before it is built.

## Decisions

- **D1 - the declarations (FR-001)**: `emit_svg`'s `rect` gains a `data-id` argument and `caption` a `names` argument; the
  written caption carries `data-names` listing the drawn shapes it names. Each call site names the shape(s) the caption is
  about: a zone's, a building's or a room's own rect; the dais and each clerk's seat; the bath, a well, a latrine, every tub, the
  notice board; EVERY straw mat (the hand sheets' form: the caption names all the mats of its group - plan review round 1:
  naming only the last mat would hide the entry's 'one mat' difference before D2 measures it); the striking posts' two circles. Where the composer seats a caption on ground that
  is not a drawn shape (a block's name in its rear alley, `_rear_band`), the declaration names the block itself - that IS the
  subject difference the entry names, and the harness counts it. No invisible stand-in is added (the entry counts those as a
  difference). Nothing else changes: the composer still seats by its own subjects, so every seat is unchanged and a test
  asserts the declared draft's caption positions equal the undeclared draft's.
- **D2 - the harness (FR-002)**: on the declared draft, `C` = the composer's seats as emitted, `H` = `labels.hand_sheet.seat` on
  the same text. Variants of the composer's seating, each one source swapped for the hand-sheet placer's: the obstacle view
  (`hand_sheet.classify` over the drawn sheet less its captions, in place of `emit_svg`'s own obstacle list and the roofed
  court's late obstacles), the subject (`hand_sheet.subjects` over the declared parts), the width (`char_w_of` per caption in
  place of `CHAR_W_EM`); and the two fixes as the entry words them - fix 1 the composer indexing with `classify` (its own
  subjects), fix 2 the hand-sheet placer taking the composer's subjects. For each caption whose `C` and `H` differ by more than
  1 px it records the sources that remove the difference; one no source removes is reported with its cause (strictness, order,
  clearance, repair) and kept out of N. Recorded in `measurements.json`.
- **D3 - the switch (FR-003)**, decided by D2's measurement (m:caption-disagreements, 2026-10-11): of 45 captions, 11 seat
  apart; 6 are explained by the three sources - the obstacle VIEW 5 (garden, straw mats, practice ground, two wells), the
  SUBJECT 1 (the fire-water tubs: the composer names the roomiest tub, the declaration all of them), the WIDTH 0. Fix 1 (the
  composer indexing with `classify`) removes the 5; fix 2 (the hand-sheet placer taking the composer's subjects) removes 2, the
  residence and the gatehouse, which no single source explains (an order interaction), and none of the 6. So, per source:
  VIEW - fix 1: `emit_svg` builds each caption's index with `hand_sheet.classify` over the sheet it has drawn (its captions not
  yet written), the seated captions added as now, and no obstacle list or late obstacles of its own; SUBJECT - the composer
  takes the hand-sheet placer's reading of the declared subject (`hand_sheet.subjects` over the declared parts, first
  subject), which removes the tubs' difference where fix 2 removes none of the subject-source ones; WIDTH - unchanged (no
  difference). The 5 the three do not explain (residence, gatehouse, cell and two clerks: order, clearance or repair, and one
  clerk where the hand-sheet seat covers ink) are reported, not unified (FR-003). After the switch the harness re-runs: the 6
  go to 0, each remaining disagreement listed with its cause.
- **D4 - strictness under the one view (FR-004)**: a seat is free when it touches no ink the caption does not name: the
  `inner` obstacles `classify` marks for the caption's own subject (its partitions, its mats) do not make a seat unfree; every
  other weighted obstacle does, as today. Foot growth (`CAPTION_GROWTHS`) and the refusal message are unchanged.
- **D5 - performance (FR-005)**: the example's gen timed before and after (`make map ... PROFILE=1`); `make perf-report` read;
  any band crossed explained and audited.
- **D6 - tests**: `tests/test_compound.py` keeps its refusal test unchanged; a declarations test (D1, seats unchanged); the D3
  switch's tests as D3 settles them, with 100% coverage of what changes.

## Constitution Check

- XVI literal: the entry's "measure first which disagreements each removes" is D2, run before D3 is chosen.
- XIII/XIV: the refusal test and the pool sheet's checks hold; any finding the re-seating causes is fixed here.
- VI: D5.
- Occasions: `layout-revised: county-magistracy-example` (its captions re-seated) - one `building-review` after D3 lands.

decisions.summary: rect gains data-id, caption gains names/data-names; each caption names its zone/building/room rect, dais, each clerk's seat, bath/well/latrine/every tub/board, EVERY straw mat, the striking posts' two circles; rear-alley captions name the block; no stand-ins; seats unchanged, held by a test (built, 1eec1030f).
decisions.why: FR-001. Round 1's D1-mats item is resolved: the mats caption now names every mat (compound.py names=drawn[first:]), the hand sheets' form; 'every tub' likewise. The figure m:caption-disagreements reproduces (11 apart, 6/5/1/0, fix 1 5, fix 2 2) on re-run.

decisions.summary: Harness: C vs H on the declared draft; one-source-swapped composer variants (view, subject, width) and the entry's two fixes; differences over 1 px attributed, the rest reported with cause.
decisions.why: FR-002 as worded ('hand_sheet.subjects over the declared parts'). The built harness departs from it in the SUBJECT toggle (see D3-SUBJECT); D2's text itself is faithful.

decisions.summary: Fix 1: emit_svg builds each caption's index with hand_sheet.classify over the drawn sheet, no obstacle list or late obstacles of its own; seated captions added as now.
decisions.why: The entry's fix 1, supported by the measurement. Seated captions 'as now' (not the hand sheet's WEIGHT_TEXT plus keep) is the clearance difference FR-003 leaves out of scope.

decisions.summary: The composer takes hand_sheet.subjects over the declared parts, FIRST subject only.
decisions.why: FR-002/FR-003 toggle and then unify 'the subject' as the hand-sheet placer reads it, and hand_sheet.seat's one() reads it as the ORDERED LIST subjects(own, size), tried in turn (inside first, then beside), first free seat winning, else least cost. Head-only leaves the subject source differing for every caption whose first subject (an area: placer.py seats an area only inside) has no free seat, so FR-003's 'the three sources no longer differ' is not met. It also invalidates the figure: harness.py line 78 takes [0], so m:caption-disagreements' by_source and residual causes were measured one way and stated as 'the subject' another. Independent check (my own variant, not the plan's figure): with view, width and the FULL ordered list the composer agrees with H on 44 of 45 captions; with the first subject only, 31 of 45 - the latrines, notice board and wells, which agree today, would move apart. Fix: the harness's SUBJECT variant tries every hand_sheet.subjects entry in order as one() does; D3's SUBJECT switch does the same in the composer (strict on each in order, growth/refusal only when none is free); re-measure and amend D3's figures.

decisions.summary: Width unchanged: the composer keeps CHAR_W_EM because width explained no disagreement.
decisions.why: The entry names the width measure as one of the three causes; User Story 1 asks for 'one measure of its width'; FR-003 ends 'so the three sources no longer differ'. Zero moved seats on one example's 45 captions is a fact about this example, not about the source, which still differs (a bold or capitalized caption measured narrower than drawn is also an SC-002 overlap risk). Keeping CHAR_W_EM preserves behavior the GM named as a difference. Fix: the composer measures each caption with hand_sheet.char_w_of.

decisions.summary: The 5 disagreements the three sources 'do not explain' (residence, gatehouse, cell, two clerks) are reported, not unified; N = 6 goes to 0.
decisions.why: Which disagreements fall outside the three sources is decided by the attribution, and the attribution rests on the mis-measured SUBJECT toggle (D3-SUBJECT), so N and the residual set are an unmeasured premise deciding FR-003's scope. My independent run with the three fully swapped seats residence, gatehouse, cell and one clerk at H's seat (only one clerk stays apart) - a check, not a figure for the plan. Fix: N and the residual list come from the corrected harness; every disagreement the corrected three-source variant removes is in N and goes to 0.

decisions.summary: Strictness: classify's inner obstacles for the caption's own subject (its partitions, its mats) do not make a seat unfree; every other weighted obstacle does.
decisions.why: Reverses round 1's 'within': round 1 read D4's words against the spec's; reading classify shows they do not match. FR-004 and User Story 2 waive the ink a caption NAMES ('judged against the ink a caption does NOT name, never against its own parts'). classify's inner=True marks every shape inside the subject's outline other than the outline - partitions, a court's buildings, a well in a court, a named room (WEIGHT_TEXT) - and marks them precisely so they are NOT waived (obstacles.py blocked() waives only non-inner parts). D1 declares a building's own rect, not its partitions, so 'its partitions' are unnamed ink and FR-004 says touching them is not free; D4 waives them, and a court's buildings with them. Not a necessity: in my check, with the full ordered subjects and inner ink blocking, every caption found a strict seat (with the first subject only, cell, clerks' room, day office and official study found none). Fix: a seat is free when it touches no obstacle outside the caption's declared_parts; an obstacle that is one of its declared shapes does not block, every other weighted obstacle, inner or not, does.

decisions.summary: Gen timed before and after, perf-report read, any band crossed explained and audited.
Refusal test unchanged; declarations test (seats unchanged); D3's tests at 100% coverage.
decisions.why: SC-002 and FR-001; tests that enforce what was asked.

decisions.summary: T01-T04 map D1, D2, D3+D4, D5 and the Occasions' building-review; D3 amended and re-reviewed before T03.
decisions.why: Mirror the plan; no task adds or drops scope.
